answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a vital anchor for AI agent identity, utilizing cryptographic attestations to ensure one entity per human. To scale, this mechanism forces an attacker to mimic the complex structure of a wharf or the organic branching of a walnut vine, requiring significant computational or social capital. Because each synthetic identity demands real-world verification, the cost of subverting the network scales linearly with the adversary’s ability to manufacture trusted human-level credentials.
